name: @screamer-labs/screamer
description: WASM build of screamer, a high-performance causal streaming time-series operator library, compiled from the same C++ core as the Python package.

scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/copy-generated.mjs dist/cjs/generated && printf '{"type":"commonjs"}\n' > dist/cjs/package.json && printf 'module.exports = require("./index.js");\n' > dist/cjs/index.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build:wasm:single && npm run build
scripts.docs: npm run build:wasm:single && typedoc && npm run build:esm && npm run docs:demo
scripts.docs:demo: mkdir -p docs-site/vendor/screamer/generated && esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2017 --outfile=docs-site/vendor/screamer/index.js && node scripts/copy-generated.mjs docs-site/vendor/screamer/generated && cp examples/live-trades.html docs-site/live-trades.html
